sv.title: Wallenberg investerar i AI-bolag från Umeå
sv.summary: Finansfamiljen Wallenbergs privata ägarbolag Wallenberg Investments investerar i AI-bolaget Algoryx som har sin verksamhet på företagsinkubatorn Uminova i Umeå.

en.title: Wallenberg invests in AI company from Umeå
en.summary: The Wallenberg finance family's private holding company Wallenberg Investments is investing in the AI company Algoryx, which operates from the Uminova business incubator in Umeå.
